new_policies.name: student-target-assignment-v1-normal
new_policies.description: Redirect one redundant capable pursuer to an uncovered disclosed mobile target, retaining each original primary pursuit.
new_policies.model: Classic Normal capability-aware public target allocation, unchanged native utilities, one reassignment, no idle-task bonus or coefficient tuning.
new_policies.information_model: Own army and public disclosed enemy ranks only; no concealed rank used.

hypotheses: Open an additional profitable front by reallocating one redundant attacker while preserving existing target primaries.
analysis: Fresh exploratory screen of unchanged native target utilities. Public retrospective opportunities were sparse (3/140 roots, one old game), so expect limited aggregate effect; distinct-task coverage can sacrifice total actor utility. Primary attacks, specialists and forcing choices preserved. No promotion without independent validation.
